race.comment: DUKE OF ZHOU (3) is a four-start Maiden who resumed for the new yard with a fading sixth over 1200m at Corowa. Maps well today in a very thin Maiden. CHOC CHIP (4) lightly raced mare resuming. Showed plenty in the first campaign, including a tidy fourth over 1180m at Gundagai last April. Fitted with the one 1000m trial and can overcome the awkward draw. SHEZRUSHIN (10) debutante daughter of Russian Revolution from Lady Mironton. Ran third at a recent trial over 1000m at Wagga Riverside on April 8. Watch the markets for any confidence. DENBURY (2) son of Denman from Miss Bradbury on debut. Comfortable trial winner. Monitor the betting.
